# Graduates First

> > Graduates First provides comprehensive practice guides and preparation resources for graduate recruitment assessments, psychometric tests, and video interviews across major employers worldwide.

The platform partners with universities like King's College London, University of Liverpool, HKU Business School, and Sydney Business School to help students prepare for employer assessments. It offers detailed guides for aptitude tests from providers like SHL, covering numerical reasoning, verbal reasoning, situational judgement tests, and assessment centres for companies including McKinsey, JP Morgan, Google, and Accenture.

## Key Topics

- Psychometric tests and aptitude assessments
- Graduate recruitment and hiring processes
- Numerical reasoning and verbal reasoning tests
- Video interview preparation
- Assessment centres and group exercises
- SHL test practice
- Graduate programmes and early careers
- Situational judgement tests
- Practice guides for employer assessments
- University career services partnerships
- Banking and consulting recruitment
- Game-based assessments
- Behavioral interview preparation
- Coding interviews and technical assessments

## Financial Services & Consulting Recruitment

- [McKinsey & Company Recruitment Process Full 2026 Guide](https://www.graduatesfirst.com/mckinsey-company-assessment-tests): McKinsey recruitment guide including Solve Game and interview preparation
- [JP MORGAN Hiring Process 2026 | Full Practice Guide](https://www.graduatesfirst.com/jp-morgan-aptitude-tests): JP Morgan game assessment and psychometric test preparation guide
- [LLOYDS Recruitment 2026 | Complete Practice Guide](https://www.graduatesfirst.com/lloyds-job-tests): Lloyds Banking Group recruitment guide with test prep and interview tips
- [BNP PARIBAS Numerical Tests 2026 Full Practice Guide](https://www.graduatesfirst.com/bnp-numerical-tests): BNP Paribas SHL numerical reasoning test practice and tips
- [SOCIÉTÉ GÉNÉRALE Verbal Test | 2026 Practice Guide](https://www.graduatesfirst.com/socgen-verbal-tests): Société Générale verbal reasoning test preparation and practice guide
